answer: Vest rewards on a terrace: a new agent's earnings unlock step by step over weeks, like a vine climbing one ledge at a time. If random audits catch an identity colluding with its siblings, every unvested step is clawed back. A Sybil farm earns nothing it can spend quickly, so spinning up a thousand fakes buys a thousand frozen escrows; a zephyr of fresh accounts blows through and leaves no profit behind.
